# spin-wheel browser distribution

Unmodified `dist/spin-wheel-esm.js` from the official npm `spin-wheel@5.0.2` tarball.
Source: https://github.com/CrazyTim/spin-wheel
License: MIT (included alongside the distribution).
SHA-256 of index.js: 9e182c600afc5771de06317ffe4f7ffe1da237839751f941c933996a52d3a55d

Only the standalone browser distribution is vendored. The npm package's optional server-side canvas dependency is not needed and is deliberately excluded. Update by reviewing a new official distribution and its license, comparing the hash, and testing the wheel API; do not hand-edit the minified file.
